text:
Happy Thursday! It's another mild, muggy morning, and a round of showers is moving in from the west. Expect on and off rain from about 7 this morning into the early afternoon, heaviest between 8 and 10. It's not a soaker, though. Most of us will see only around a tenth of an inch, with a brief downpour possible near midday. A south wind will be gusty too, with gusts near 30 mph. Highs land near 68, a little cooler than Wednesday.

Showers turn more scattered this evening and wrap up around 11, and a rumble of thunder isn't out of the question. The Euro and one other model are wetter than the official forecast today, so keep the umbrella handy until bedtime. Tonight stays mild, with a low around 51.

Friday looks mostly dry and partly sunny, with a high near 64 and a light northeast breeze. One model hints at a spot shower, but I'd bet on dry. Enjoy it, because the weekend turns showery and much cooler, with highs back near 50 on Saturday.
